It turns the previously undifferentiated `composition_modified` audit stream into a readable, filterable, granular per-composition history with a dedicated UI. The audit infrastructure already existed (central `AuditService` + `AuditEventBuilder`); this work standardized event types, the old/new diff contract, a `reason` field, the read path, and the frontend.\n\n**Source documents (cross-links):**\n- Plan: [../composition-action-history-PLAN.md](../composition-action-history-PLAN.md) ΓÇö full implementation plan, current-state analysis, field conventions (┬º3.2 DetailsJson contract), decisions (┬º9), staged execution order.\n- Spec: [../composition-action-history-spec.md](../composition-action-history-spec.md) ΓÇö domain requirements (NotebookLM / SP_v_3.pdf).\n- i18n templates: [../composition-history-i18n-templates.md](../composition-history-i18n-templates.md) ΓÇö header-sentence + diff/label key set (note: task #203 matched the COMPONENTS over the template where they diverged).\n\n### The 6 decisions (PLAN ┬º9)\n\n1. **Granular event types** ΓÇö replaced the single `composition_modified` with per-action types (`composition_created/_updated/_deleted/_status_changed/_cloned`, `carriage_added/_updated/_removed`, `carriages_reordered`, `seats_blocked/_unblocked/_sold/_released`), reusing the existing `AuditMessages.RailRun` keys. Each event carries a standardized `DetailsJson` with `compositionId` (always, even on carriage/seat events), `old`/`new` diff, and `reason` where applicable. (Tasks #191ΓÇô#197.)\n2. **C1 read path** ΓÇö no new schema; the read reuses the central audit API with new `compositionId`/`carriageId` query params. Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/audit-logs/compositions` ΓåÆ `PagedResult<AuditLogSummaryDto>`. compositionId/carriageId discoverability is enabled by enriching `SearchText` at ingestion (task #198), not provider-specific `JSON_VALUE`. (Tasks #198ΓÇô#199.)\n3. **Composition-read permission** ΓÇö the new read path is scoped under the EXISTING composition-read right (`AuthorizePermissions(ResourceCodes.Composition, AccessLevel.ReadOnly)`), NOT `JOURNAL.ReadOnly`. Implemented as a separate `GetCompositionHistory` controller action so journal authorization stays cleanly separated. (Task #199.)\n4. **Hybrid SeatAuditLog** ΓÇö the legacy local `SeatAuditLog` table stays as a fast seat-map detail source; the composition history reads the central audit instead. No migration now; long-term deprecation. `LogSeatAction` writes left untouched. (Task #196.)\n5. **Global history page + editor link** ΓÇö a standalone `/compositions/history` page (accordion list with human-readable headers + formatted ╨ƒ╤Ç╨╡╨┤╨╕/╨í╨╗╨╡╨┤ diff + raw JSON behind a toggle), a sidebar menu item under \"╨Ü╨╛╨╝╨┐╨╛╨╖╨╕╤å╨╕╨╕\", and an \"╨ÿ╤ü╤é╨╛╤Ç╨╕╤Å\" button in the composition editor that opens it pre-filtered by `?compositionId=`. A WAGON filter switches wagons by changing the filter (no navigation in/out). NOT under \"╨£╨╛╤Å╤é╨░ ╨░╨║╤é╨╕╨▓╨╜╨╛╤ü╤é\".
